scheme_name: Rastriya Arogya Nidhi - Health Minister’s Cancer Patient Fund
other_conditions: Applicant must be a cancer patient living below the poverty line.
Employees of Central Government, State Government, or PSU are not eligible.
Assistance is only for treatment in the 27 designated Regional Cancer Centres.
The scheme cannot be used where cancer treatment facilities are available free of cost.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹5 lakh per patient (maximum ₹15 lakh overall) for cancer treatment, covering radiation, chemotherapy, surgery, bone‑marrow transplantation and diagnostics.
